summary: Quantify how stereotyped functional connectivity is across zebrafish larvae by vectorising each larva's FC matrix upper triangle and correlating every pair of larvae, then ordering the resulting larva-by-larva similarity matrix from most to least representative and rendering it as a lower-triangular heatmap.
use_when: Run the Inter-larva FC stereotypy from upper-triangle correlations recipe

Quantify how stereotyped functional connectivity is across zebrafish larvae by vectorising each larva's FC matrix upper triangle and correlating every pair of larvae, then ordering the resulting larva-by-larva similarity matrix from most to least representative and rendering it as a lower-triangular heatmap.
avoid_when: The intended conclusion requires causal inference from an observational association alone
